sanskrit: kṣā cāsi kṣamā cāsi tasyās te bhūtaṃ ca subhūtaṃ ceti mukhe | tābhyāṃ te vidheyaṃ tābhyāṃ te namas tābhyāṃ no mṛḍa tābhyāṃ no 'dhi brūhi tābhyāṃ no 'bhi jighra | māteva putraṃ piteva sūnum ayaṃ te asmi taṃ mā mumugdhi grāhyā bandhebhyo vimadaṃ nayemam ||
english: You are Kṣā and you are Kṣamā; in your mouth are Being and Auspicious-Being. To those two of yours we are subject; to those two of yours we bow; by those two be gracious to us, speak over us, breathe upon us. As a mother to a son, as a father to a son — this one here am I; release him not, O Seizer; lead this man forth, freed from the bonds of possession.
